Retain completed capture as diagnostic evidence after cleanup failure, never overall success. AdmissionError includes rollback; WorkError, ExecutionErrors and reverse-order CleanupErrors remain distinct, preserving original identity and aggregate boundaries without flattening or automatic release retry. Cancellation of a wait does not drain or release admitted raw work. Sequential gate composition only, with concurrent/reentrant reuse refused. Close revokes new work while actual resources remain retained for admitted raw work. Copy/project before IPC and withhold stale/unauthorized/late evidence. Existing lifetime/outcome signatures suffice for this bounded need.

originalExceptionGraphDisposition: Accept original Exception/Data/InnerException references only as local diagnostics, not immutable or sanitized transport objects. Do not recursively traverse arbitrary Data/InnerException/provider graphs, invoke revoked node getters, or serialize raw exceptions. Preserve local identity/deduplication and provider aggregate boundaries. Before IPC create an allowlisted bounded DTO with phase/channel, stable classification/code and controlled generic explanation; redact credentials in separately supported URI fields. Omit arbitrary exception Message/stack/Data/InnerException text by default. Bound diagnostic count/text to the frame and release local raw references after handling. Projection failure cannot turn an unsuccessful run into success. No new Core diagnostic transport signature is needed; actual implementation/qualification remains pending.
